title: Online degree guide India: choosing between IITM BS and IIT Patna
summary: Compare exact degree titles, admission routes, assessment travel, total cost and evidence of outcomes before choosing an online or hybrid programme.
content:
Direct answer: Choose an online degree by checking the exact programme, its admission and assessment rules, the time you can commit and the full cost. “IIT online degree” is too broad to make a useful comparison. This guide focuses on IIT Madras BS Data Science and Applications and IIT Patna CSDA.

Start with the award, not the advertisement

Write down the full degree title, awarding institution, entry route and intended exit award. Keep degree programmes separate from short certificates and coaching. Ask for the current prospectus and your cohort’s rules before paying. An institution’s reputation does not tell you whether a particular delivery mode suits your schedule.

For a focused shortlist, read our IITM BS versus IIT Patna comparison. IIT Patna’s AICS track is explained separately because it is a different specialisation.

Can you study entirely from home?

Do not infer “no travel” from online teaching. IITM requires travel to assigned exam centres. IIT Madras: admissions and qualifier requirements. For Patna, obtain written cohort-specific attendance, laboratory and examination requirements; our checked curriculum does not establish a complete attendance policy.

Use a decision worksheet

QuestionEvidence to collect
Am I eligible?Official eligibility rules for the exact intake, including required subject background and selection steps.
Can I attend assessments?Exam locations, dates and any campus or laboratory requirements.
Can I sustain the workload?A weekly study calendar tested alongside work or your other degree.
Can I afford the full programme?Tuition, exam charges, repeats, travel, accommodation, devices and internet.
Are outcomes relevant to me?A programme-specific graduate report with cohort size and reporting period.

Budget beyond tuition

Use three scenarios: completion without repeats, one repeated course, and an additional travel or accommodation requirement. Record the date of each price and whether it covers the certificate, BSc, BS or another exit. Avoid comparing a first-semester advertisement with another programme’s full-degree fee.

Evaluate career claims

Ask which programme the graduates studied, how many responded, whether they were already employed, and whether a salary figure is a median, average or highest offer. A list of employer logos cannot answer these questions. We do not assign a universal “best degree” or promise placements.

Our practical recommendation

Make your own shortlist using eligibility, timetable, learning interests and budget. This is editorial advice, not an admissions decision. If travel is impossible, resolve that issue before optimising for brand name. If time is tight, test a realistic study week before committing to a heavier course load.

Next steps

Read the IITM programme guide and the IIT Patna guide. Then browse IITM subject resources and, if useful, our existing course catalogue. GenZ courses provide learning support; they do not award university degrees.

title: IITM BS vs IIT Patna CSDA: an evidence-based comparison
summary: Compare IIT Madras BS Data Science and Applications with IIT Patna CSDA, including eligibility, study mode, costs, curriculum and evidence gaps.
content:
Direct answer: IITM BS and IIT Patna CSDA have different admission routes and programme structures. Choose using your eligibility, subject interests, assessment travel and verified cohort costs. Available evidence does not justify naming either a universal winner.

What exactly are we comparing?

The IITM programme here is BS in Data Science and Applications. The Patna comparator is BS in Computer Science and Data Analytics (CSDA) through CET. Patna also publishes an Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security (AICS) curriculum; it is not interchangeable with CSDA.

Official facts checked on 6 October 2026; missing evidence is marked explicitly.
FactorIITM BS Data ScienceIIT Patna CSDA
AdmissionRegular qualifier route; JEE-based entry is separate. IIT Madras: admissions and qualifier requirements.10+2 Science, minimum 60% cumulative, plus an accepted selection route. IIT Patna CET: eligibility.
Learning and physical attendanceOnline learning with in-person assessments. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees.The curriculum specifies practical work and projects; it does not settle current compulsory campus attendance. Obtain the intake’s delivery policy.
Curriculum emphasisData science and programming. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees.CSDA includes computing, analytics and projects. IIT Patna CET: four-year CSDA curriculum.
FlexibilityCourse-based registration and multiple exits. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees.Modular entry, exit and re-entry advertised; verify operational rules for your cohort. IIT Patna CET: eligibility.
FeesSee the cohort-specific range in our IITM guide.Current all-in tuition total not verified. Published service charges are not a full tuition quote. IIT Patna CET: academic service charges.
OutcomesAsk for degree-programme cohort evidence.Comparable CSDA graduate statistics not verified in the checked sources.

CSDA and AICS are separate decisions

AICS includes Foundations of Cyber Security and Cyber Security Essentials. IIT Patna CET: four-year AICS curriculum. CSDA’s four-year structure includes statistics and advanced machine learning. IIT Patna CET: four-year CSDA curriculum. Read the complete curricula and compare the modules you actually want to study; do not treat a broad “AI degree” label as a curriculum.

How to compare costs fairly

Choose the same exit award and intake year before comparing numbers. Include tuition, exams, repeats, travel and accommodation. Request a written Patna cost schedule identifying mandatory charges. We cannot conclude that Patna is cheaper or more expensive without a verified full quote. Scholarship eligibility and your course choices can also change your personal cost.

Do either of these guarantee placements?

No placement guarantee is established by the sources cited here. Keep campus-wide statistics separate from online or hybrid degree outcomes. A useful report identifies the programme, graduation cohort, number of participants and reporting period. Different sample populations cannot support a clean salary comparison. Ask both institutions for the same measures.

Which should you choose?

Our editorial decision rule is to eliminate any option that does not fit your eligibility, travel capacity or budget, then compare learning goals. Build a sample week around actual course tasks. If a requirement is unclear, contact the programme office and retain the written response. Do not replace missing evidence with social-media certainty.

Continue your research

Start with the online degree decision guide, then read our IITM BS guide or IIT Patna guide. For IITM study support, explore subject resources and GenZ courses.

title: IITM BS degree guide: eligibility, structure, fees and study planning
summary: Understand the IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications, its qualifier route, assessment requirements and January 2026 onwards fee range.
content:
Direct answer: IIT Madras offers the BS in Data Science and Applications through staged coursework. Online teaching does not remove the need to attend in-person assessments. Check the official programme rules for your intake before applying.

Who can apply?

Class 12 or equivalent passers can apply across academic backgrounds. Mathematics and English at Class 10 are expected. Regular entry uses four weeks of English I, Mathematics I, Statistics I and Computational Thinking, followed by qualification. A separate JEE-based route exists. IIT Madras: admissions and qualifier requirements.

What is the structure?

Foundation has 32 credits. Programming and Data Science diplomas have 27 credits each. The BSc requires 114 credits and the BS 142. The published completion window is up to eight years; course prerequisites and progression rules still apply. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees.

How much does IITM BS cost?

For learners joining Foundation from January 2026 onwards, the published BS range is ₹3,86,000–₹4,50,000. Fees are paid for registered courses each term. This range is not a personal all-in quote: check fee support, repeat courses and other applicable costs. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees.

What does an ordinary study term involve?

The programme uses three terms and weekly coursework. In-person quizzes and exams require travel planning. IIT Madras: academic structure, assessments and fees. As our own study advice, put assessment dates on a calendar before choosing your course load. Reserve separate time for lectures, problem solving, submissions and revision. Do not use a video playlist as a substitute for solving unfamiliar questions.

Plan a sustainable first term

  1. Read the official rules and identify your entry route.
  2. Choose courses based on prerequisites and actual available hours.
  3. Set recurring study blocks that survive your work or college timetable.
  4. Use an error log: record why an answer was wrong and redo it later.
  5. Check exam travel and submission dates independently.

This checklist is GenZ editorial advice. It is not an official IITM registration or assessment rule.

What can the degree lead to?

Assess career options using your interests, skills, projects and degree-programme evidence. We do not infer a personal salary or admission guarantee from an institutional reputation. When reading an outcomes report, check the graduating award, sample size and whether participants were already working. Confirm postgraduate eligibility with the receiving institution.

Common questions

Is this the same as buying a GenZ course?

No. IIT Madras determines admissions, academic rules and degree awards. GenZ provides independent learning support.

Can I use archived graded assignments as current answers?

No. Archives help practise reasoning. Check your current official assignment, use your own work and follow the programme’s assessment requirements.

Next steps for learning support

Visit the IITM BS information hub, browse resources by subject and use the reviewed archive directory. Existing GenZ courses remain an optional support destination. Comparing alternatives? Read IITM BS vs IIT Patna CSDA.

title: IIT Patna online or hybrid degree guide: CSDA, AICS and evidence gaps
summary: Identify IIT Patna CSDA and AICS correctly, check official eligibility and curricula, and resolve attendance, tuition and outcome questions before applying.
content:
Direct answer: “IIT Patna online degree” needs an exact programme and intake. CET publishes separate CSDA and AICS degree pathways. Before applying, verify your cohort’s study mode, physical attendance and complete fees directly with CET; the sources checked here do not resolve all three.

Which programme does the name refer to?

CET lists BSc (Hons), BS and BS–MS routes of three, four and five years respectively in CSDA and AICS, with modular entry, exit and re-entry. IIT Patna CET: eligibility. Use the award you intend to complete in every cost or curriculum comparison.

Eligibility and selection

The published requirement is 10+2 Science with at least 60% cumulative, plus an accepted national/state entrance score, an accepted international test, or IITP-SAT followed by a virtual interview. Confirm which route applies to your intake. IIT Patna CET: eligibility.

How do CSDA and AICS differ?

The four-year CSDA curriculum includes Python, databases, machine learning, operating systems and projects. IIT Patna CET: four-year CSDA curriculum. AICS has dedicated cybersecurity subjects and electives such as digital forensics and penetration testing. IIT Patna CET: four-year AICS curriculum. This is a curriculum distinction, not an employment forecast.

Does online or hybrid mean no campus travel?

We have not verified a complete current attendance policy. The published project description allows online/offline project work; that does not establish the mode for all classes, labs or examinations. IIT Patna CET: four-year CSDA curriculum. Obtain written answers about mandatory attendance, exam centres, campus visits, laboratories and accommodation. Do not interpret missing instructions as permission to study entirely remotely.

What are the fees?

A verified current all-in tuition total is unavailable in our checked sources. CET separately lists an examination charge of ₹5,500 per student per semester and other academic service charges. IIT Patna CET: academic service charges. Confirm whether your cohort’s quote includes these charges; do not add them twice or present a service-charge table as degree tuition.

Ask for a dated schedule covering your intended award, payment instalments, repeats, refund conditions and compulsory travel. Keep the official reply with your application records.

Check version differences

The CSDA programme-description page labels its course structure as three-year, while the separate CSDA PDF is four-year. IIT Patna CET: CSDA programme description (three-year version) and IIT Patna CET: four-year CSDA curriculum. Do not merge their credits or completion rules. Use the curriculum identified in your admission documents.

What outcomes are established?

We have not verified comparable programme-specific CSDA/AICS graduate placement or salary statistics. A curriculum and a statement about project support are not a placement report. Ask for graduation cohort size, the number seeking jobs, the reporting period and definitions of salary measures. Avoid transferring residential-campus outcomes to a different programme.

Our application checklist

  • Record the exact award and intake.
  • Confirm your selection route and accepted evidence.
  • Get current attendance and assessment requirements in writing.
  • Budget with a complete, dated cost schedule.
  • Read the applicable curriculum rather than promotional labels.
  • Compare career evidence from the same programme population.

These are our editorial checks for applicants; the programme office makes admissions decisions. Continue with IITM BS vs IIT Patna CSDA and the online degree decision guide. For IITM learning material, browse GenZ resources.
